stages.title: CONTEMPORARY-ANCHOR DISCIPLINE
stages.terms: Contemporary-anchor discipline: ⚠️ Inference: Mention renewed interest in Indian logical traditions only as a bounded introduction or conclusion.

stages.answer: ✅ Search finding: A live August 2026 search located broad educational and academic discussion of Indian Knowledge Systems and classical Indian logic, but no sufficiently direct official doctrinal development specific to Nyāya–Vaiśeṣika.

stages.title: MASTER DISTINCTION GATEWAY
stages.terms: Master verdict: Nyāya–Vaiśeṣika is a realist system in which a detailed ontology is disclosed through valid cognition, error is a misrelation among real factors, and liberation follows removal of false knowledge.
stages.mechanism: Master verdict: Nyāya–Vaiśeṣika is a realist system in which a detailed ontology is disclosed through valid cognition, error is a misrelation among real factors, and liberation follows removal of false knowledge.
stages.consequence: Memory line: seven categories prevent unlike kinds of reality from being confused.
stages.trap: ✅ Its concern is not logic in an abstract formalist sense alone, but valid cognition as a means to the removal of error and finally liberation.
